blocks.text: Alexandra Eala’s Wuhan Open campaign ended in the first round, after a three-set loss to the Chinese qualifier Han Shi, 6-4, 3-6, 3-6. Wuhan, a Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) 1000 event, was Eala’s first tournament since she won a bronze medal in the Asian Games. Shi will next face Leylah Annie Fernandez, who recently won the Singapore Open, in the round of 32. Like Eala, Shi is only 21. But she is 198 spots lower in the WTA singles rankings, at 217.
